request.query: logarithm of natural floor of real power greater than half exponent logarithm

items.name: Int.log
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semifield R] → [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] → [FloorSemiring R] → ℕ → R → ℤ

items.name: Nat.clog_pow_left
items.type: ∀ (b k n : ℕ), Nat.clog (b ^ k) n = (Nat.clog b n + (k - 1)) / k

items.name: Real.log_pow
items.type: ∀ (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), Real.log (x ^ n) = ↑n * Real.log x

items.name: Real.floor_logb_natCast
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ} {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → ⌊Real.logb (↑b) r⌋ = Int.log b r

items.name: Int.log_of_one_le_right
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : FloorSemiring R] (b : ℕ) {r : R},
  1 ≤ r → Int.log b r = ↑(Nat.log b ⌊r⌋₊)

items.name: Nat.le_pow_iff_clog_le
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x y : ℕ}, x ≤ b ^ y ↔ Nat.clog b x ≤ y
